/-!
# Erdős Problem 73

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/73](https://www.erdosproblems.com/73)
- [Re99] Reed, B., Mangoes and Blueberries. Combinatorica (1999), 267-296.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Erdos73

/--
Let $k\ge 0$. Let $G$ be a graph such that every subgraph $H$ contains an independent set of size
$\ge (n-k)/2$, where $n$ is the number of vertices of $H$. Must $G$ be the union of a bipartite
graph and $O_k(1)$ many vertices?

Proved by Reed [Re99].

The linked formal proof (Alexeev and Codex, following Reed's mangoes-and-blueberries argument)
states the hypothesis as `∀ H : G.Subgraph, H.verts.ncard ≤ 2 * H.coe.indepNum + k` and the
conclusion as `(G.induce Dᶜ).IsBipartite`, for graphs on `Fin n` (and, equivalently, on any
finite vertex type); this implies the statement below.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5, formal_proof using lean4 at
  "https://github.com/plby/lean-proofs/blob/8822f7ddef30fadbd92e1c6ab4ed897af356af5e/src/latest/ErdosProblems/Erdos73.lean#L122"]
theorem erdos_73 : answer(True) ↔
    ∀ (k : ℕ), ∃ (C : ℕ),
      ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
        (∀ (S : Finset V), ∃ (I : Finset V), I ⊆ S ∧ (G.induce (I : Set V)).edgeSet = ∅ ∧
          (I.card : ℝ) ≥ (S.card - k : ℝ) / 2) →
        ∃ (D : Finset V), D.card ≤ C ∧
          (G.induce (D : Set V)ᶜ).Colorable 2 := by
  sorry

-- TODO: Add variants of the problem.

end Erdos73

reformulations.difference: The source quantifies over every subgraph H. Lean instead quantifies over vertex subsets S and asks for a subset I whose induced graph has no edges. The conclusion expresses bipartiteness as Colorable 2.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Apply the source hypothesis to the induced subgraph G[S] to obtain Lean's witness I. Conversely, for any subgraph H with vertex set S, an independent set of G[S] remains independent in H, because deleting edges cannot destroy independence. An edgeless induced graph on I is exactly an independent set, and the real inequality |I| ≥ (|S|−k)/2 is equivalent to |S| ≤ 2|I|+k. Mathlib defines IsBipartite as Colorable 2. In /workspace/review/scratch.lean, hypotheses_equivalent proves equivalence with ∀ H : G.Subgraph, H.verts.ncard ≤ 2 * H.coe.indepNum + k; source_rhs_equiv lifts it to the complete uniformly quantified conclusion without changing C. Both proofs use only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.
